Manhattan SCALE 2016 WMS Software Engineer 
 
This can be done mostly remote, but there will be periodic visits needed to the distribution center in Lithia Springs, GA. 
 
 About the Opportunity 
This is a hands-on software development position requiring direct, professional experience working with Manhattan SCALE 2016. 
The ideal candidate combines advanced Microsoft SQL Server development skills with strong application programming experience and a practical understanding of warehouse operations, material handling equipment, and distribution center workflows. 
We are looking for a developer who understands not only how to write and troubleshoot code, but also how that code impacts the physical movement of inventory throughout a warehouse. 
This is not a database administration, reporting, or functional WMS analyst position. This role requires someone who can independently develop, modify, troubleshoot, and support software solutions within a Manhattan SCALE 2016 environment. 
 
 What You'll Do 
 Manhattan SCALE 2016 Development & Support 
 
	 Develop, maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance applications and functionality within Manhattan SCALE 2016. 
	 Write, modify, test, and deploy code to support warehouse operations and business requirements. 
	 Investigate application issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable technical solutions. 
	 Support existing customizations, system interfaces, and enhancements within the WMS environment. 
	 Collaborate with IT and distribution center leadership to identify opportunities for system improvements. 
 
  SQL Server & Software Development 

 
	 Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, and other database objects. 
	 Troubleshoot SQL Server performance issues and application-related database problems. 
	 Develop and maintain application logic, interfaces, and integrations using the programming languages and technologies supporting the WMS environment. 
	 Analyze application and database issues to improve system performance, reliability, and data integrity. 
	 Create technical documentation for application enhancements, integrations, and system changes. 
 
  Warehouse Operations & Equipment Integration 

 
	 Understand the end-to-end distribution center workflow, including receiving, inventory management, replenishment, picking, packing, and shipping. 
	 Support WMS integrations with warehouse equipment and technology, such as RF scanners, barcode systems, material handling equipment, and automated processes. 
	 Troubleshoot issues involving communication between the WMS, warehouse equipment, and other business applications. 
	 Work directly with warehouse operations teams to understand how system functionality impacts productivity, accuracy, and order fulfillment. 
	 Translate operational challenges into effective technical solutions. 
 
  System Integration & Continuous Improvement 

 
	 Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot integrations between Manhattan SCALE and other enterprise applications. 
	 Participate in system enhancements, testing, implementation, and ongoing application support. 
	 Identify opportunities to improve system efficiency, automate manual processes, and optimize warehouse workflows. 
	 Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure technical solutions align with business and operational needs. 
 
  What We're Looking For 
 Required Qualifications 

 
	 Hands-on professional experience developing, customizing, maintaining, or supporting Manhattan SCALE 2016 WMS. This experience is mandatory. 
	 Strong Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL development experience, including complex queries, stored procedures, and performance troubleshooting. 
	 Demonstrated software development experience, including writing, modifying, debugging, and maintaining application code. 
	 Experience developing or supporting integrations between warehouse management systems and other applications or warehouse technologies. 
	 Strong understanding of warehouse and distribution center business processes. 
	 Familiarity with warehouse equipment, material handling systems, RF devices, and the relationship between physical warehouse operations and WMS functionality. 
	 Ability to independently investigate technical issues, identify root causes, and develop solutions. 
	 Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills. 
	 Ability to work collaboratively with both technical teams and distribution center operations personnel. 
 
    Preferred Qualifications 

 
	 Experience with Manhattan SCALE versions beyond 2016. 
	 Familiarity with Manhattan Active Warehouse Management. 
	 Experience with .NET, C#, or other application development technologies relevant to the existing WMS environment. 
	 Experience supporting high-volume retail, e-commerce, or omnichannel distribution operations. 
	 Experience with warehouse automation, conveyors, sortation systems, or other material handling technologies. 
	 Experience supporting mission-critical applications in an active distribution center environment.
